title: Dynamic AI Demands Drive Memory Diversity
summary: EE Times examines AI data center memory hierarchy, including Sean Dougherty on MRAM, persistent memory and Everspin UNISYST for edge AI.]
body_markdown:
In this EE Times article, Gary Hilson looks at how AI is changing the memory hierarchy across data centers, networks and edge systems, and why different workloads require different memory technologies.


Everspin Vice President of Worldwide Sales & Marketing Sean Dougherty explains where MRAM and persistent memory fit as AI inference moves closer to the edge, including the ability to retain data through a power interruption. He also discusses how Everspin’s UNISYST MRAM can support applications that have traditionally relied on NOR flash and the role of non-volatile memory in edge AI systems.
